Soulbound is the property of an item that prevents it from being traded or mailed to another character or sold in the Auction House. Items usually become soulbound one of five ways: * Acquiring the item marked as "Bind on Pickup". Items given as quest rewards are usually BoP. Looting a BoP item should give you a warning alert that this item will bind to you. * Equipping an item that is marked as "Bind on Equip". You should get a warning alert that this item will bind to you. Most of the better equippable items bind on equip. * Acquiring an item that is marked as "Bind on Equip" through a Need roll (as of patch 4.2.0). * Using an item that is marked as "Bind on Use". * Using certain enchants

A soul bag (often referred to as a shard bag) is a bag used by Warlocks to hold more Soul Shards than they would normally be able to carry in conventional containers. The soul bag consumes a regular container slot, however, so it reduces the number of available slots for non-Soul Shard items. The value of the trade-off is up to the individual Warlock. Soul Shards harvested by the Warlock are automatically stored in an equipped soul bag when acquired, making tedious Soul Shard housekeeping a thing of the past. Helpfully, soul bags also display the number of soul shards stored within them on the bag icon on the container toolbar.

Soulstarve Hood drops from Illysanna Ravencrest in Black Rook Hold.
The Soulsap Shackles drop from Inquisitor Tormentorum in the Vault of the Wardens.
Soulbound Destructors are eredar that appear during the battle for the Broken Shore and during the assault on Broken Shore. They also appeared at Legion Invasion locations.
Soulbound Protectors are eredar that are located at the Legion Invasion Locations.
__NOTOC__ Soulthirster is a helsquid located in southwestern Helheim, in the waters near the Eternal Battlefield.
Soul Shadows is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Catlike Reflexes (rogue artifact trait) and Shadow Nova traits.
Soulfiend Tagerma is a kvaldir located aboard the Naglfar in the Maw of Souls.
Soulforge Guardians are felguard found in the Assault on Broken Shore scenario.
Soul of the Slaughter was an Arms warrior artifact trait. It was linked to the Storm of Swords (artifact trait) and Executioner's Precision (artifact trait) traits.
Soulgaze Inquisitors are inquisitors located in Invasion Points.
Soul Shackle is a reward from Where In the World is Mathias?: Altar of End Times.
Soultrapper Mevra is part of The Soultakers, world bosses introduced in World of Warcraft: Legion. She is found inside the Shrine of the Truthguard in Shield's Rest, Stormheim.
Soultwisted Echo are ur'zul located at Exodus Point in Eredath. They are attacking, and sometimes even devouring Horrified Echoes.
The Soultwisted Monstrosity is an ur'zul located at Triumvirate's End in Eredath.
Soulstealer Tirant was a jailer located in Legion Camp: Ruin in Azsuna until being defeated by the champions of the Silver Hand.
__NOTOC__ Soul Ruin is a location in Broken Shore. Mephistroth's Legion ship crashed there. There are many skeletons lying around.
Soulgorged Gravestalkers are skeletal hounds located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar. __NOTOC__
Soul Skin is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Firm Resolve and Sharpened Dreadfangs traits.
